name: AMB Cinemas to DLF Cyber City Corridor
chokePoints: Sarath City Mall parking entry & exit queue
DLF Street Food curb parking & entrance gate
trafficPatterns: Direct short 3.2 km straight corridor down Gachibowli-Miyapur Road. The multi-level Kothaguda flyover provides a direct non-stop elevated bypass over the Botanical Garden signal.

routeOptions.name: Gachibowli-Miyapur Road via Kothaguda Flyover
routeOptions.description: The only direct, fast route. Takes the Kothaguda elevated flyover directly past Botanical Garden straight into DLF Cyber City.

name: Financial District to DLF Cyber City Corridor
trafficPatterns: Two distinct viable driving choices: Wipro Circle Road (shorter, direct arterial) vs ORR Service Road (longer distance, avoids Wipro Circle ground signal).

routeOptions.name: Wipro Circle Road
routeOptions.description: Direct arterial link from Financial District through ISB road and IIIT Hyderabad junction.

routeOptions.name: ORR Service Road / Nanakramguda Exit
routeOptions.description: Longer distance via ORR service lane; bypasses internal circles but slows down near Gachibowli stadium.

name: Cyber Towers to Mindspace & Raidurg Corridor
trafficPatterns: Heavy tech park traffic. Direct Hitec City flyover vs Durgam Cheruvu cable bridge bypass.

routeOptions.name: Durgam Cheruvu Cable Bridge Bypass
routeOptions.description: Skips Cyber Towers signal directly into Knowledge City and Mindspace.

routeOptions.name: Hitec City Main Flyover Road
routeOptions.description: Direct arterial road, but heavy bottlenecks at Inorbit signal.

name: Gachibowli to RGI Airport (Shamshabad)
peakHours: Evening toll queues on Sundays; free-flowing on ORR weekdays
trafficPatterns: Two primary airport express options: Outer Ring Road (100-120 km/h signal-free expressway) vs PVNR Elevated Expressway (via Mehdipatnam).

routeOptions.name: Outer Ring Road (ORR Expressway)
routeOptions.description: Recommended from Gachibowli/Financial District. 100 km/h access-controlled expressway with zero traffic lights.

routeOptions.name: PVNR Elevated Expressway via Mehdipatnam
routeOptions.description: Elevated corridor for Central Hyderabad travelers, but requires negotiating Gachibowli ground signals first.
